Thanks Marissa — a few quick thoughts.

On the high level, I think the deciding signal is whether the role has ongoing people management and prioritization responsibility across teams, rather than a single project lead. One direct report immediately (IC managing an ops hire) doesn't automatically mean the manager track.

Can you confirm:
- Will Elena own performance reviews for the direct report?
- Is she expected to own PM/roadmap level decisions or mostly execution/ops ownership?
- Headcount impact: is this a new HC against manager bucket or coming from IC budget (req-265 is new HC, please confirm source).

If it's limited to ops coordination and no direct P&L/roadmap ownership, my leaning is Senior IC (L5) with a manager-title exception only if she will truly be people manager and the role will carry manager career expectations. Otherwise IC with technical lead title and leadership leveling.

Also, the base of $215k looks high for L5 in our west-coast bands unless offset with equity. Karthik, can you map the numbers to the published band anchors and confirm whether sign-on $20k + 0.25% equity keeps total comp within the L5 midpoint +/- 10%?
